newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle slow at $63 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle slow at $63 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area early Tuesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were steady, with last established trade.

Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 5,900 slaughter steers and 3,800 heifers; 31,500 head confirmed for week to date which includes 20,100 formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 63.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 63.00.
